scope: Facade-window washing and assisted glass installation: three exact configurations, with operating-mode and buying-market limits.

records.name: Skyline Ozmo · BMU installation
records.exactConfiguration: Ozmo robotic-arm system integrated with a building maintenance unit; site-engineered facade configuration, hardware revision unreported.
records.description: Supervised robotic facade washing with a documented New York installation; German delivery and building-specific integration remain unresolved.

operatingMode.value: Robotic cleaning movements supervised by a trained human using a rooftop computer.
caveats: A building-specific access unit, installation and operating method are required.
No unrestricted autonomy or all-weather operation is established.

conditions: Sensor configuration and accuracy are not specified.
No allowable contact-force range was published.
A product feature claim, not a reviewed functional-safety rating.
Compatibility is building-specific.
Not published in reviewed sources; obtain the building-specific load schedule.
Marketing stability language does not define a permitted weather envelope.

taskEvidence.task: Wash exterior glazing at 1133 Avenue of the Americas, New York.
taskEvidence.configuration: Ozmo integrated on the 45-storey building, with Palladium Window Solutions and Durst; announced August 2024.
taskEvidence.operatingMode: Human rooftop supervision during robotic cleaning.
limitations: Initial commercial deployment announcement is retained conservatively as a site introduction; no measured long-term operation interval was reviewed.
No accepted-area, intervention, weather downtime or total labour denominator.

records.name: Smartlift SL 609 HLE RT

operatingMode.value: Human-controlled powered travel and vacuum lifting; optional wireless remote must be specified.
caveats: Tracking and stored positions do not establish autonomous installation.
People prepare suction contact, guide placement and complete glazing blocks, beads and fixings.

conditions: Not available across the entire reach envelope; use the configuration's load chart.
A separate load condition from the 600 kg maximum.
Exact glass geometry and yoke orientation affect usable installation height.
Confirm options and load before transport/floor-load planning.
Not a guaranteed doorway or turning clearance.
Duty cycle, battery state and lifting load are unspecified.
70 cm plus 90 cm extensions; verify allowed load at the required reach.

limitations: No exact HLE RT glass-installation job with measured cycles or operator effort was reviewed.

records.name: Riebsamen Glasboy 380 · 600 kg suction setup
records.exactConfiguration: Glasboy380 tracked crane with 600 kg vacuum-head option; 1000 kg suction configuration is excluded.
records.description: Radio-controlled glass-positioning crane; manufacturer rental is available only with specialist personnel.

operatingMode.value: Human-controlled hydraulic crane and vacuum head; radio-control equipment must be confirmed in the offer.
caveats: Hydraulic tilt, slew and rotation assist people; installation is not autonomous.
Stabilisers, ground bearing, suction contact and the reach-dependent load chart govern lifting.

conditions: 600 kg option, not capacity at all boom radii; 1000 kg is a different head/package.
No 600 kg load is implied at maximum outreach.
Confirm exact 600 kg package and options.
Stabiliser working footprint is larger.
Transport configuration must be confirmed.
Glass load and boom setup change the operating footprint.
Distinguish crane slew from the separate glass-head rotation.

taskEvidence.task: Handle large glass panes and position them at building openings.
taskEvidence.configuration: Glasboy380 manufacturer application page with job photographs; 600/1000 kg head options shown in the range.
taskEvidence.operatingMode: Controlled by an operator; rental requires specialist personnel.
limitations: Photos and application descriptions do not provide accepted-cycle or labour denominators.
Exact head package in each illustrated job is unidentified.
The machine does not install glazing blocks, fasten beads or seal joints.

buyingRoutes.deliveryStatus: Published enquiry route; exact configuration, stock, delivery and service terms require a written quotation.

Site bearing, stabiliser clearances, glass geometry and permitted wind.
Exact rental or sale package and lead time.
